'''Bror Jace's T-65 X-wing''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] purchased for the [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferran]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] after he reunited with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] following his presumed [[Death/Legends|death]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Thyferran had it painted in red with green trim --the corporate colors of Zaltin-- and had been checked out on within three hours of his arrival.|Description of Bror Jace's X-wing.|<ref name="BW" />}}
Following the revelation that [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Flight officer/Legends|Flight Officer]] [[Bror Jace]] had faked his death in order to help the [[Zaltin Corporation]] in their plans to betray the [[Bacta Cartel/Legends|Bacta Cartel]], the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] technician, [[Zraii]], purchased a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]] for the returned pilot. Jace used this X-wing to join the AWOL members of Rogue Squadron, now going by "[[Antilles's Rogues]]", in their private war against [[Ysanne Isard|Ysanne Isard's]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].{{Fact}}

To ensure the Antilles's Rogues appeared distinct from the New Republic, the squadron each added their own unique paint job to their X-wings. Bror Jace chose to paint his starfighter in the colors of the Zaltin Corporation as a sign of his loyalty to them. Jace piloted his X-wing in numerous skirmishes in what would become known as the [[Bacta War]], culminating in the [[Battle of Thyferra]], wherein the Antilles's Rogues were able to successfully liberate Jace's homeworld from Isard's clutches.<ref name="BW" />
